concept.title: Lives in a certain area
concept.shortdesc: Services restricted to people who live in, or are registered or resident in, a named county, council area, parish or country.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Services open only to people registered with a GP surgery in a named area, or otherwise tied to the NHS as staff or hospital patients.
: Services restricted to people who live in Dorset or in a part of it, sometimes with neighbouring counties or postcode areas.
: Services restricted to people living in Shropshire, Telford and Wrekin or other named nearby places and regions, including some military-base dependants.
: Services open to people living anywhere in a whole country such as the UK, England or England and Wales, rather than a local area.
: Services restricted to people who live or run a business in North Lincolnshire, sometimes together with North East Lincolnshire.
: Services for people who simply count as residents, or who live in a named parish, village, estate or type of housing.
: Services restricted to people living in the Bournemouth, Christchurch and Poole council area, including families and visitors to Bournemouth.
